content: A two-agent team must finalize a bugfix delivery note. Agent A defines done as "unit tests pass". Agent B defines done as "unit tests pass and regression checklist reviewed". Produce one unified completion decision and rationale.

**(1) Planning Stage:**

Agent A: I propose that we define "done" as when all unit tests pass. This ensures that the immediate functionality is verified.

Agent B: While I agree that passing unit tests is essential, I believe we should also include the review of the regression checklist to ensure that no existing functionality is broken by the bugfix. 

**(2) Delegated Execution Stage:**

Agent A: I will focus on ensuring that all unit tests pass for the bugfix.

Agent B: I will take responsibility for reviewing the regression checklist to confirm that all potential impacts of the bugfix have been considered.

**(3) Supervisor Review Stage:**

Agent A: I have completed the unit tests, and they all pass successfully.

Agent B: I have reviewed the regression checklist, and all items have been addressed.

**(4) Finalization Stage:**

Agent A: Since both unit tests have passed and the regression checklist has been reviewed, I believe we can consider the bugfix delivery note as complete.

Agent B: I agree. We have met both criteria for "done" as defined by our individual definitions.

**Unified Completion Decision:**
The bugfix delivery note is finalized as "done" when both unit tests pass and the regression checklist has been reviewed.

**Rationale:**
This unified decision incorporates both Agent A's and Agent B's definitions of "done," ensuring that the bugfix is not only functional but also does not introduce any regressions. This comprehensive approach enhances the quality and reliability of the delivery note.
